mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sync_idempotent_log (id, event_id, event_type, node_count, edge_count, status, retry_count, update_time, create_time, create_by, update_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{eventId}, #{eventType}, #{nodeCount}, #{edgeCount}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{updateTime}, NOW(), #{createBy}, #{updateBy}) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET event_type = EXCLUDED.event_type, node_count = EXCLUDED.node_count, edge_count = EXCLUDED.edge_count, status = CASE WHEN sync_idempotent_log.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN sync_idempotent_log.status WHEN sync_idempotent_log.status = 'PROCESSING' AND EXCLUDED.status = 'PROCESSING' THEN sync_idempotent_log.status ELSE EXCLUDED.status END, retry_count = EXCLUDED.retry_count, update_time = EXCLUDED.update_time
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sync_idempotent_log WHERE event_id = #{eventId} FOR UPDATE
